inputs.description: Structured STEP model provided to the mesh generator.

step_model.description: Parsed STEP model represented as structured geometry/topology data.

config.description: Configuration parameters used during this mesh generation run. Included for reproducibility and documentation.

tolerance.description: Geometric tolerance used during STEP parsing, surface reconstruction, and point-in-solid classification.

max_element_size.description: Maximum allowed mesh element size used when computing grid resolution.

min_element_size.description: Minimum allowed mesh element size used when computing grid resolution.

results.description: CFD-ready domain representation: grid extents, resolution, and solid/fluid/wall mask.

grid.description: Structured grid extents and resolution for Navier–Stokes solver.

mask.description: Solid/fluid mask for Navier–Stokes solver. Canonical flattening: i + nx*(j + ny*k). Mapping: -1 = Wall (Boundary Condition), 0 = Solid, 1 = Fluid (Interior).
